name: POPS4 — what exists, and where
what: One index card for the whole house, so nobody has to guess a URL to find out what is here. Written because two separate AI reviews on 2026-09-21 each concluded a live surface was missing after guessing at paths that never existed.
maintainer: Jenny Huang Goodman MPA MSc MHSA, Principal — HAKO SHIKIN LLC, Virginia Beach, trading since 1997
attribution: Free to use with credit to POPS4.

house.shape: One house, two faces, and they pay for each other.
house.record: Edgar and Edgarette read what companies file with the SEC and put it in public, free, the day it is filed: nine boards, an actuarial reading of any US filer, and a forecast ledger scored in the open. It earns nothing directly. An open record anyone can check is what makes the house worth believing.
house.supply: Corporate identity programs since 1997 — 70,000+ products from 200+ authorized brands: corporate gifts, branded apparel, custom packaging, secure print, and the programs around them. One roof, one quote, no platform fee. This face pays for the other.
house.why: Procurement is mostly noise — chasing quotes, proofs and stock across four vendors who each own one piece. The house takes that away. The filing boards are the same instinct pointed at information: the answer is already in a public document, so stop making people hunt for it.
house.forMachines: Both faces answer machines directly, free and without a key. That is deliberate: an agent can read a company's filings and price the program that filing calls for, in one session, with no login on either side.

theLedger.what: Pre-registered 80% ranges on next-year revenue, fingerprinted before the outcome and scored when the company files its annual report.
theLedger.anchor: Committed daily to a public git history. The timestamp is GitHub's, not ours — anyone can recompute a hash, nobody can back-date somebody else's commit.
theLedger.scale: Evaluation-sized, not training-sized. Stated before anyone has to ask.
theLedger.notAdvice: A range is arithmetic, not a forecast. Nothing here is investment advice.
